```{r}
# ============================================================
# Fuga dei Cervelli - Serie Storiche per Paese
# Grafici: Gini Index | GDP Growth | Unemployment
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

# ---- 1. CARICAMENTO DATI -----------------------------------

df_raw <- read.csv(
  "Indicatori GIni, DIsoccuazione, GDP, GDP Pro Capite ecc World Data Bank.csv",
  check.names = FALSE,
  na.strings = c("..", "NA", "")
)

# Paesi di interesse
target_countries <- c("USA", "GBR", "ESP", "NLD", "DEU", "FRA", "CHN", "BRA", "BEL", "ARG", "VEN")

# Indicatori di interesse (nomi esatti come nel dataset)
target_series <- c(
  "Gini index",
  "GDP growth (annual %)",
  "Unemployment, total (% of total labor force) (national estimate)"
)

# ---- 2. PULIZIA E RESHAPE ----------------------------------

# Colonne degli anni
year_cols <- grep("^\\d{4}", colnames(df_raw), value = TRUE)

df_long <- df_raw %>%
  filter(
    `Country Code` %in% target_countries,
    `Series Name`  %in% target_series
  ) %>%
  select(`Country Code`, `Country Name`, `Series Name`, all_of(year_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(year_cols),
    names_to  = "Year_Label",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Year  = as.integer(str_extract(Year_Label, "^\\d{4}")),
    Value = as.numeric(Value)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value))

# Etichette leggibili per le serie
df_long <- df_long %>%
  mutate(Indicator = case_when(
    `Series Name` == "Gini index"                                                           ~ "Gini Index",
    `Series Name` == "GDP growth (annual %)"                                                ~ "GDP Growth (annual %)",
    `Series Name` == "Unemployment, total (% of total labor force) (national estimate)"    ~ "Unemployment (% labour force, national est.)",
    TRUE ~ `Series Name`
  ))

# ---- 3. PALETTE COLORI E TEMA COMUNE ----------------------

# Palette qualitativa con 11 colori distinti
country_colors <- c(
  "USA" = "#E63946",
  "GBR" = "#457B9D",
  "ESP" = "#F4A261",
  "NLD" = "#2A9D8F",
  "DEU" = "#264653",
  "FRA" = "#E9C46A",
  "CHN" = "#C0392B",
  "BRA" = "#27AE60",
  "BEL" = "#8E44AD",
  "ARG" = "#1ABC9C",
  "VEN" = "#D35400"
)

tema_base <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40", hjust = 0),
    plot.caption     = element_text(size = 8,  color = "grey55", hjust = 1),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.title     = element_blank(),
    legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92"),
    axis.title.y     = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40"),
    axis.title.x     = element_blank()
  )

caption_text <- "Fonte: World Data Bank | Elaborazione: ricerca fuga dei cervelli"

# ---- 4. GRAFICO 1 – GINI INDEX ----------------------------

df_gini <- df_long %>% filter(Indicator == "Gini Index")

p1 <- ggplot(df_gini, aes(x = Year, y = Value, color = `Country Code`, group = `Country Code`)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8,    na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = country_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(df_gini$Year), max(df_gini$Year), by = 2)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Gini Index – Disuguaglianza del reddito",
    subtitle = "Serie storica per paese (0 = perfetta uguaglianza, 100 = massima disuguaglianza)",
    y        = "Gini Index",
    caption  = caption_text
  ) +
  tema_base

# ---- 5. GRAFICO 2 – GDP GROWTH ----------------------------

df_gdp <- df_long %>% filter(Indicator == "GDP Growth (annual %)")

p2 <- ggplot(df_gdp, aes(x = Year, y = Value, color = `Country Code`, group = `Country Code`)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8,    na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = country_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(df_gdp$Year), max(df_gdp$Year), by = 2)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Crescita del PIL (GDP Growth annual %)",
    subtitle = "Variazione percentuale annua del PIL a prezzi costanti",
    y        = "GDP Growth (%)",
    caption  = caption_text
  ) +
  tema_base

# ---- 6. GRAFICO 3 – UNEMPLOYMENT --------------------------

df_unemp <- df_long %>% filter(Indicator == "Unemployment (% labour force, national est.)")

p3 <- ggplot(df_unemp, aes(x = Year, y = Value, color = `Country Code`, group = `Country Code`)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8,    na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = country_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(df_unemp$Year), max(df_unemp$Year), by = 2)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Tasso di Disoccupazione (stima nazionale)",
    subtitle = "% della forza lavoro totale – stima nazionale",
    y        = "Disoccupazione (%)",
    caption  = caption_text
  ) +
  tema_base

# ---- 7. VISUALIZZAZIONE / SALVATAGGIO ---------------------

# Mostra i grafici in Positron / RStudio
print(p1)
print(p2)
print(p3)

# Per salvare i file (decommenta se necessario):
```
